title: Pilot Results and Security Review for Support Rollout

transcript.speaker: them
transcript.text: Hi Priya, thanks for making time today. We looked at the pilot results and the support team cut response times by about a third.

transcript.speaker: them
transcript.text: The main concern from your side was data retention. Can you tell me how long call recordings are kept?

transcript.speaker: them
transcript.text: and who on your team needs to approve the security questionnaire, we would like to roll out to 40 agents next month.

actionItems: Confirm how long call recordings are kept (Me)
Identify who approves the security questionnaire (Me)

usage.question: Assist
usage.answer:
Them asked two things: **how long call recordings are kept**, and **who approves the security questionnaire**.

I can't see those answers on your screen — it shows a coding brief (glint-goal.txt), not meeting notes or a data-retention policy. Check your notes, CRM, or the pilot agreement for the retention period (often 30/90/365 days) and the security owner (typically InfoSec, Legal, or a compliance lead).

**Suggested reply if you know the answers:**
- "Recordings are kept for [X days] and then auto-deleted."
- "The security questionnaire goes through [Name/Role] — I'll get it to them today so we can hit the 40-agent rollout next month."

If you don't know, say: "Let me confirm both and get back to you by [date]."

summaryMarkdown: The support team's pilot reduced response times by about a third. The main remaining concern is data retention, and the rollout to 40 agents is planned for next month pending security approval.
